description: Search MSHA (Mine Safety and Health Administration) mine records by operator name, controller name, or mine name. Returns matching mines with their MSHA Mine ID, status (Active, Abandoned, Intermittent, etc.), mine type (Surface/Underground/Facility), coal vs metal/non-metal classification, commodity, state, and current operator/controller. Use this to find the Mine ID(s) for a company before calling msha_mine_detail. Sourced from MSHA's own bulk mine-records file (public domain), refreshed weekly. Keyless.

query.description: Operator, controller, or mine name (or part of one) to search for, e.g. "Peabody", "Warrior Met Coal", "O'Neal Quarry".

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code to restrict the search, e.g. "WV", "KY".

status.description: Optional exact mine status filter: Active, Abandoned, "Abandoned and Sealed", Intermittent, "New Mine", NonProducing, "Temporarily Idled".

name: msha_mine_search
title: Msha Mine Search
